messages:
zoe: quick heads-up 9 SDK change caused routing confusion. TS client started inlining route metadata into the JSON body under "_route_meta" instead of sending X-Route header. gateway/router only looks at headers for fast-path routing, so requests showed correct route in traces but were routed to default pools.

marc: ouch. any repro?

zoe: minimal repro (curl):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"hi","_route_meta":{"route":"low-latency"}}'
```

fiona: gateway used to accept route in header only. we never parsed body for routing because body-inspection is slow and unsafe. why did the client change this?

kevin: we added the convenience layer to keep headers small (browsers) and avoid CORS preflight for browser SDKs. it stashed the hint in body. missed that router doesn't look there.

zoe: result: console trace shows metadata (we instrument body->traces), but routing decision already happened at gateway; billing increments default pool. bad mismatch.

marc: mitigation: (1) quick patch to TS/python clients to restore header X-Route for server contexts (2) gateway short-term: if body contains _route_meta and header absent, extract route into a synthetic header before routing (case: only internal codepath) and emit metric routing.body_migrated_count, (3) console: add a dashboard tile that compares routehint (trace/body) vs routed_pool (router logs) so we can catch regressions.

fiona: agree. gateway fallback is ugly but necessary for immediate relief. need to audit for security (only allow extraction for known content-types and size limits).

kevin: I'll cut the TS/py PRs to restore header behavior and add explicit opt-in for body hints behind a flag BROWSER_ROUTE_IN_BODY=true.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: gateway-body-route-extract -> canary (3 nodes) by fiona at 6201239020

marc: console tile mock: columns tenant | route_hint_source (header/body/none) | routed_pool | mismatch_count(24h). add alert when mismatch_rate > 0.2% for paid tenants.

fiona: I'll implement gateway extraction with strict checks: only JSON content, key _route_meta.route string, payload <2KB, and tenant not in blocklist. will add unit tests and metric routing.body_migrate_failures.

kevin: timeline: client patches within 2 hours; gateway canary now; console tile within 24h. also add a runbook section: how to triage header vs body routing mismatches.

zoe: thanks. once clients release we should notify integrators and add a short FAQ in docs about browser SDK behavior and CORS tradeoffs.

marc: long-term: update router to support a validated body-hint path if teams want that, but prefer explicit opt-in and tenant controls. add an integration test exercising browser-sdk->gateway->router->console mapping.

console-bot: Dashboard proposal saved to drafts: /console/dashboards/routing_hint_mismatch (owner: marc).

deploy-bot: Canary finished: gateway-body-route-extract (status: healthy) at 6201239120
